one_line_summary: [Zn1.5(pbdc)(ATAZ)(OH)] shows thermal_stability_no_weight_loss_until = 360.0 K for target gas

key_insights.title: Mechanism
key_insights.body: 3D pillar-layer framework with 2-fold interpenetrated pcu network and large rectangular channels occupied by an identical net → porosity

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] use hydrothermal in situ ligand synthesis to construct a novel MOF → effective for constructing novel MOFs

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] generate aminotriazole ligands through in situ decarboxylation during synthesis → aminotriazole can be obtained in situ for MOF construction

key_insights.title: Failure
key_insights.body: [performance_regression] heat compound 1 above 360 °C: the framework rapidly lost weight and the skeleton collapsed

notable_quotes: 7-hydroxy-5-methyl-1,3,4-triazaindolizine unexpectedly ring-opened in situ to 3-amino-1,2,4-triazole in the presence of Zn(II) ions.
Compound 1 is thermally stable with no weight loss before 360 °C, but its framework collapses rapidly on further heating.
Compound 1, [Zn1.5(pbdc)(ATAZ)(OH)]n, was synthesized via in situ aminotriazole formation and confirmed by elemental, thermal, single-crystal and powder XRD analyses.
